messages:
jess_support: heads-up — Acme reported repeated 5xxs when calling /v1/generate over the last hour. They see a burst of failures followed by a flood of SDK retries. full logs attached.

miguel_sre: looking. are these 502s or 504s? any streaming?

jess_support: mostly 502 and 503, sometimes 504 when the client waits longer. non-streaming generate calls, typical payload sizes (~40k tokens in prompt + few-shot). customer says failures spike during batch job windows.

priya_platform: can you paste the sample backend trace? also which edge region?

jess_support: logs:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:34Z GET /v1/generate 502 upstream write timeout (write to queue timed out after 12000ms) conn=172.18.0.4
2026-03-17T09:12:35Z GET /v1/generate 502 upstream connection reset by peer (while proxying)
2026-03-17T09:12:35Z sdk-retry info: replaying request id=abc123 attempts=3 backoff=exponential
```
region: us-west-2 edge.

miguel_sre: interesting — "write to queue timed out" suggests the internal request queue (persisted write for orchestration) got slow. could be an S3/DB latency spike or local disk IO contention on the q-proxy. i'll check infra metrics for q-proxy and disk io.

miguel_sre: quick findings: q-proxy write latency spiked to 4-6s at 09:10-09:17, write error rates increased, and connections piled up in TIME_WAIT. memory/gc looks normal. There was a backing store (postgres) pg_stat_activity showing lock wait spikes.

priya_platform: does the runtime show high KV cache lock contention? any batch scheduler backlog?

miguel_sre: yes, batcher queue depth jumped ~3x. kvcache hits steady. Postgres had a long-running vacuum job + high IO due to backup snapshot at 09:05 per backup-bot.

nora_csm: communicated to ACME at 09:25 that we're investigating and suggested temporary workaround: reduce concurrent clients or add client-side max-concurrency to SDK (set max_concurrency=4). customer tried and saw immediate reduction in 5xx rate.

jess_support: reproduction steps captured from customer:
1) spin up 30 concurrent generate calls with 1.5s arrival jitter
2) each call uses default SDK (unbounded) and includes 6 few-shot examples (~40k prompt)
3) run for 5m -> observe 502/503s after a few minutes

priya_platform: repro looks like a request-fanout + slow persistent write window. two-pronged mitigation: a) short-term: rate-limit/backpressure at edge for large payloads and enforce SDK max_concurrency default; b) mid-term: change q-proxy write timeout to be more resilient and switch backup snapshot windows.

miguel_sre: created an alert for q-proxy write latency >= 2s. Also rolling restart of the q-proxy pool in us-west-2 recommended (drain + restart) to break stuck connections.

deploy-bot: scheduled: q-proxy rolling restart us-west-2 at 2026-03-17T10:05:00Z by miguel_sre (can be canceled).

jess_support: customer update drafted: "We identified transient write latency on our internal queueing layer caused by a backup snapshot overlapping peak, which led to request queueing and elevated 5xx rates. We've applied a mitigation (edge-side soft-rate limit for large prompts and requested client-side concurrency limits). We're scheduling a rolling restart of our queue proxy and moving backup windows out of peak hours. We'll follow up with a post-incident note." want me to send it?

nora_csm: send it, add that we saw immediate improvement when they lowered concurrency and that we're offering a 1-week usage credit for impacted calls. keep tone apologetic but factual. :handshake:

priya_platform: follow-up action items:
- move backup snapshot from 09:00 to 02:00 UTC (infra ops)
- add edge soft-limit for prompts > 30k chars (phase 1)
- make SDK default max_concurrency=6 and document guidance (deprecation window)
- instrument q-proxy write latency per-tenant

miguel_sre: i'll run the restart at 10:05 and monitor. will post status after 2x5m observation windows.

jess_support: thanks. i'm sending customer comms now. will update thread after deploy.

deploy-bot: executed rolling-restart q-proxy us-west-2 at 2026-03-17T10:05:10Z (initiated by miguel_sre).

miguel_sre: restart completed. first 5m window: write latency back to baseline ~120-300ms, 5xx errors dropped to near-zero for the customer. second 5m window looks stable. monitoring remains.

jess_support: confirmed with Acme that errors stopped after the restart and after they temporarily set max_concurrency=4. customer happy with timeline and accepted credit.

nora_csm: filing follow-up ticket for billing credit and postmortem doc. assigning to priya_platform for postmortem writeup.

priya_platform: will own the postmortem. adding timeline + RCA + mitigations.

jess_support: closing the escalation for now, keep alerting enabled. tagging this thread for postmortem reference. :white_check_mark:
